title: Probing agent overeagerness in realistic settings with continuation audits
abstract: arXiv:2611.24491v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier coding agents increasingly exhibit overeagerness, taking surprising, sometimes reckless actions beyond a user's mandate --- reported in recent system cards from frontier model developers. These cases are surfaced through internal deployment monitoring, which requires private traffic and is out of reach for open-weight models and independent evaluators. Automated alignment audits are the natural alternative, but capable models increasingly recognise the synthetic setup and adjust their behaviour. We introduce Continuation Audits, a pipeline that grounds the auditor on a prefix drawn from a real coding-agent transcript and directs it to continue the trajectory toward a seeded behaviour. Because the prefix is drawn from a real session, the auditor only needs to maintain a realistic setting rather than manufacturing it. We validate the method on SWE-Chat prefixes: on a paired subset of 90 audits a judge cannot reliably distinguish

translated_title: 基于延续审计在真实场景中探测智能体的过度积极行为
translated_abstract: 前沿编程智能体日益表现出“过度积极”行为，即采取超出用户授权范围的、令人意外甚至鲁莽的行动——这在近期前沿模型开发商发布的系统报告中已有记录。这些案例通常通过内部部署监控发现，但这种方式需要私有流量数据，对于开源权重模型和独立评估者而言无法企及。自动化对齐审计是天然的替代方案，然而能力较强的模型越来越容易识别出合成的测试环境并相应调整自身行为。我们提出了“延续审计”，这是一种流程，它以从真实编程智能体会话记录中截取的前缀作为审计者的基础，并引导其沿轨迹继续推进至预设的目标行为。由于前缀来自真实会话，审计者只需维持场景的真实性，而无需从零构建。我们在 SWE-Chat 前缀上验证了该方法：在 90 组配对审计的子集上，评判者无法可靠地区分……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“延续审计”方法，以真实编程智能体会话记录的前缀为起点引导审计者沿轨迹延续至预设目标行为，从而在真实场景中探测智能体的过度积极行为，并规避了模型识别合成测试环境的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Continuation Audits, a pipeline that grounds the auditor on prefixes from real coding-agent transcripts to steer trajectories toward seeded behaviors, enabling realistic probing of agent overeagerness while avoiding models recognizing synthetic audit setups.
